verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਧ ਨਾਥ ਜੋਗੀ ਜੋਗ ਧਿਆਨ ਮੈ ਨ ਆਨ ਸਕੇ ਬੇਦ ਪਾਠ ਕਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਦਿਕ ਨ ਜਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: sidh naath jogee jog dhiaan mai na aan sake bedh paaTh kar brahamaadhik na jaane hai ||

en.bdb: The Supreme, absolute, true Lord whom Sidhs, Yogis and Naths could not bring in their perception, who could not be known by Brahma and other deities despite contemplation of Vedas;

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਯਿਾਤਮ ਗਿਆਨ ਕੈ ਨ ਸਿਵ ਸਨਕਾਦਿ ਪਾਏ ਜਗ ਭੋਗ ਮੈ ਨ ਇੰਦ੍ਰਾਦਿਕ ਪਹਿਚਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: ayiaatam giaan kai na siv sanakaadh paae jag bhog mai na i(n)dhraadhik pahichaane hai ||

en.bdb: The Lord who could not be realised by Shiva and four sons of Brahma, nor by Indra and other such deities who resorted myriad yags and penances;

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਕੈ ਸੇਖਾਦਿਕ ਨ ਸੰਖਯਾ ਜਾਨੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਚਰਜ ਨਾਰਦਾਦਿਕ ਹਿਰਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: naam simaran kai sekhaadhik na sa(n)khayaa jaanee brahamacharaj naaradhaadhik hiraane hai ||

en.bdb: Whom Shesh Naag with his thousand tongues could not comprehend and speak out all names of the Lord; bewildered by His magnificence, even the celibate sage Narad gave up the search out of frustration,

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਾ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਕੈ ਅਪਾਰ ਕੋ ਨ ਪਾਰ ਪਾਇਓ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਮਨਿ ਮਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥੨੧॥
verses.translit_en: naanaa avataar kai apaar ko na paar paio pooran braham gur sikh man maane hai ||21||

en.bdb: About the infinitude of which Lord, Vishnu in spite of manifesting in so many incarnations, could know nothing. Satguru manifests Him in the heart of his obedient devotee. (21)
